title: Private node watchdog: node-drift detector and region fallback policy for residency enforcement
creator: Priya Narang
description: Implement a lightweight node-level watchdog and automated reporting pipeline for Private/VPC deployments that detects locality drift, enforces configured retention windows, and triggers controlled regional fallback when strict residency constraints are violated. The feature aims to provide deterministic, auditable evidence for residency compliance and automated remediation steps that avoid data exfiltration while minimizing customer outages.
acceptance_criteria: Watchdog agent runs on private nodes and emits signed heartbeat attestations containing node zone, instance id, boot time, and active mount points
System detects when a tenant's active connection is routed to a node outside the tenant's allowed regions within 60s and surfaces a compliance alert
Automated retention enforcer can reconcile and correct per-tenant retention metadata and produce an immutable, downloadable evidence bundle for audits
Region-fallback policy enacts a graded response: notify -> soft-quarantine -> connection-drain -> block (configurable by tenant), documented in audit logs
End-to-end test coverage with simulated network partition and region-swap demonstrating correct alerting, rollbacks, and no data replication to forbidden zones
Console UI exposes per-tenant residency status and recent attestations within the Compliance > Residency tab and an API endpoint to fetch evidence bundles
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Define attestations payload and signing model. Use HSM-backed key per-cluster to sign node heartbeats.
Phase 2: Build lightweight watchdog daemon (Go) that collects node metadata and pushes to residency-collector via gRPC with TLS and mTLS.
Phase 3: Residency-collector validates signatures, applies policy evaluation, writes immutable events to tamper-evident ledger (append-only S3 with object versioning + signed manifest).
Phase 4: Retention reconciliation worker that compares retention metadata, runs fixes (eg. anonymize/expunge) under a configurable dry-run window, and records actions in evidence bundles.
Phase 5: Console and API surface for alerts, evidence export, and per-tenant policy overrides; add canary rollout to select customers on Dedicated and Private.
Phase 6: Chaos tests and compliance report generation job; finalize docs and run security review.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Priya Narang: Initial ticket created after post-incident review for INC-2026-011. Primary goal: reduce manual forensics time and prevent silent region drift.

2026-03-03 - Liam O'Connor: Spike completed. Implemented prototype signed heartbeat with node metadata. Found that existing node agent image lacks a stable uid for signing key; proposing cluster-level HSM key instead.

2026-03-05 - Security (Marta Ruiz): Recommended HSM-bound keys and minimal attestation payload to avoid leaking tenant RIDs. Also requested crypto review for signature rotation and key compromise scenarios.

2026-03-07 - SRE (Ethan Wang): Raised concern about increased 1s heartbeat load for very large clusters. Proposal: adaptive heartbeat frequency (1s for suspect nodes, 30s baseline) and sampling for low-risk nodes.

2026-03-09 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented residency-collector validation, wired to append-only ledger S3 prefix. End-to-end smoke in staging passed for single-tenant flow. Opening PR for collector and ledger writer.
2026-03-11 - Product (Sofia Patel): Confirmed console UX requirement: per-tenant timeline view and evidence export in zip with signed-manifest. Also requested CSV export for compliance teams.
2026-03-12 - Liam O'Connor: Work in progress: retention-reconciler skeleton added. Demo scheduled with Compliance on 2026-03-18.
risks: Heartbeat load could increase control-plane costs for very large private fleets if not sampled/adaptive.
Misconfigured fallback policy may cause unnecessary customer downtime; require per-tenant opt-in for hard-block steps.
Attestation signing keys are a single point of trust — need robust key rotation and compromise procedure.
Automated retention fixes must be reversible within a grace window to avoid data loss from false positives.
notes: This ticket intentionally separates detection (watchdog + attestations) from remediation (reconciler + fallback) so we can provide a monitored, staged rollout and limit blast radius. Coordinate with Solutions Eng for enterprise customers who require custom fallback SLAs.
